title: LeetCode 27: Remove Element
description: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `val`, remove all occurrences of `val` and return the remaining elements.
constraints:
0 <= len(nums) <= 100
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
starter_code:
def remove_element(nums: list[int], val: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def remove_element(nums: list[int], val: int) -> list[int]:
    return [x for x in nums if x != val]
explanation: Filter elements not equal to val in O(N) time.
